retrieved_sources.title: Supported OS & Kernel Combinations - PipelineHub CI/CD Build
retrieved_sources.text:
Overview
--------

This document outlines the current status and results of supported operating system (OS) and kernel combinations for image builds in PipelineHub CI/CD pipelines. As PipelineHub' support expands to additional distributions and kernel variants, this page may serve as a central reference for compatibility notes and validations. 

Background
----------

Production builds primarily take place using Enterprise Linux 8 (aka EnterpriseLinux8) built on VMs running EnterpriseLinux8 UEK 7 (Unbreakable Enterprise Kernel). To ensure broad compatibility and provide flexibility, PipelineHub has begun evaluating builds across multiple Enterprise Linux versions, EnterpriseLinux8 & EnterpriseLinux9, using VMs running differing EnterpriseLinux8 UEK versions (UEK6, UEK7).

Supported CI/CD Combinations
----------------------------

The following summarizes a set of tests executed to verify compatibility and extend support for additional configurations.  
 

| Base Image OS | Build Kernel | Compile | Docker Creation | Publish | Support | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EnterpriseLinux8 | OL8u10 UEK7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported | Baseline |
| EnterpriseLinux8 | OL8u6 UEK6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |
| EnterpriseLinux9 | OL8u10 UEK7 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |
| EnterpriseLinux9 | OL8u6 UEK6 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | GreenSupported |  |

========

SecurityScan Scans are able to be run on both services and applications. For services, one may be triggered on a service version or an individual snapshot. For applications, SecurityScan Scan can only be triggered at the application version level.

retrieved_sources.title: Lifecycle hooks CI/CD
retrieved_sources.text:
### Step 3: Include Publish Step in CI and trigger pipeline

Configure the CI steps to include **Publish** step, then trigger the pipeline. This will build the Lifecycle Hooks and produce them as Docker containers.

### Step 4: Reference Lifecycle Hooks in the Spec File of Another Workload Artifact

In the target workload artifact (e.g., a microservice application component) where the generated Lifecycle Hooks should be applied -

#### Step 4.1: Modify the osspArtifact.yaml File to Include Lifecycle Hooks

In the **lifecycleHooks** section of the osspArtifact.yaml file (for the target workload artifact, a microservice application component), refer to the [Build Artifact Reference Resolution User Guide - BOM Format Instructions](#) for detailed guidance on how to substitute the newly generated Docker image.

#### Step 4.2 Trigger pipeline

Initiate the pipeline for this component. The Lifecycle Hooks from **Step 3** will be included in the artifact publish output.
